data_description.target_low: Initial value; adjustable on the hygrostat afterwards.
data_description.target_high: At least 5 % above the humidify target (dead band).
data_description.min_on: Windows and locks still switch off immediately.
data_description.sensor_stale: 0 = off. Everything is switched off then.

data_description.season_method: Automatic: equivalent humidity, else heating limit, else always.
data_description.heating_limit: 24 h mean outdoor temperature below = season.
data_description.season_band: For equivalent humidity (± around the target).
data_description.condensation_limit: Lower the target automatically in frost.
data_description.condensation_offset: Plus for good glazing, minus for old windows.

data_description.tank_detection: Via the trend of absolute humidity.
data_description.tank_slope: If absolute humidity falls at least this fast while running, the tank is considered empty.
data_description.cleaning_interval: Runtime hours; 0 = off. Season start always requests cleaning.
data_description.home_keeper: Only if Home Keeper is installed.
